claude_proposed_widenings.name: FeatRecord
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. There is no FeatRecord. feat_root is a v4 source atom and feats are a distinct SRD unit type with mechanics unlike class features (no className, no acquiredAtLevel, different prerequisite model). A FeatRecord kind + feat mechanics family are both missing.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Great Weapon Fighting — Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_substitute (surface shape for die-result floor)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The core mechanic is a die-result substitution: any damage die showing 1 or 2 is treated as 3. This is not a numeric delta (modify_roll_numeric adds a fixed bonus), not advantage/disadvantage, and not a standard reroll (a reroll could produce another 1 or 2; substitution floors at 3). v4 taxonomy lists modify_roll_reroll and modify_roll_substitute as Effect Atoms, but neither appears in types.ts as a typed surface shape. A new variant is required that specifies scope (damage rolls), threshold (die result ≤ 2), and replacement value (3).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_always_on mechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Great Weapon Fighting is unconditionally active whenever the weapon condition is met — no activation, no resource, no reset cadence. ClassFeatureActivationMechanics requires activationCost + resource (use_count) + resetCadence. Even activationCost: free implies an active choice on the player's turn. A passive/always-on mechanics family is needed for feats and class features that are perpetual modifiers conditioned on equipment or circumstance.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property to gain this benefit.
